# Bytecode Instructions

## Compile BytecodeDemo

```bash
javac app/src/main/java/com/practice/bytecode/BytecodeDemo.java
```

## Inspect bytecode with javap

```bash
javap -c -p app/src/main/java/com/practice/bytecode/BytecodeDemo.class
```

## What the bytecode shows

- `iconst_6` and `iconst_7` load integer constants onto the stack.
- `imul` multiplies the two integers.
- `istore_2` stores the result in a local variable.
- `getstatic` loads `System.out` for printing.
- `invokevirtual` calls the `println` method.

## Explain generated bytecode

Java source code is compiled into bytecode instructions for the Java Virtual Machine (JVM). Bytecode is platform-independent and executed by the JVM. The `javap` tool shows how methods, variables, and operations are translated into low-level JVM instructions.
